tests.description: fire_behavior-derived test (EqWeFiC Phase 1, PLAN.md 1.3). Reference: NCAR fire_behavior (develop @ eb77580, default real32 build, gfortran 13.3 -O2 in the EqWeFiC container) running its test7 case (80x80 fire cells of 25 m, dt = 0.5 s, num_tiles = 1), dumped in-model by the ctessum-claude/fire_behavior fork (branch earthsciml-instrumented, c9dda02, -DESM_DUMP=ON; summary output bit-identical to the uninstrumented build). Single-precision source: rel 1e-5 (CLAUDE.md contract), abs 1e-7 where a value is exactly 0 or 1. Regime: Calc_fire_fluxes (physics/fire_physics_mod.F90) at cell (i,j) = (17, 62) of the 20th step: grnhft = (dmass/dt)(1 - bmst) CMBCNST and grnqft = (bmst + (1 - bmst) 0.56)(dmass/dt) XLV with dmass = fuel_load_g fuel_frac_burnt_dt and bmst = M/(1 + M) are ALGEBRAICALLY IDENTICAL to Mandel et al. (2011) eqs 4-5 as written here (1 - bmst = 1/(1 + M_f); bmst + (1 - bmst) 0.56 = (M_f + 0.56)/(1 + M_f)) with fuel_burn_rate = fuel_frac_burnt_dt/dt, w_l = fuel_load_g, h_fuel = CMBCNST = 1.7433e7 J/kg (fire_behavior's value, not the 1.8608e7 default), M_f = fmc_g = 0.08, L_water = XLV = 2.5e6 J/kg.
